result.title: HiUni: Harmonizing Understanding and Generation in Shared Visual Space
result.summary: Unified multimodal models aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single framework. However, prevailing approaches often separate their visual representations or backbone computation to accommodate the different requirements of these two tasks, which limits the degree of unification. In this paper, we present HiUni, which revisits this design choice and explores whether a pretrained vision language model can be directly extended into a unified model with extensive parameter sharing. Specifically, HiUni reuses the same language-aligned ViT and dense Transformer backbone for both capabilities, while confining task-specific computation to the output side. Yet such a design introduces two key challenges. Generation in pixel space is difficult to optimize, and semantic abstraction in pretrained ViT discards fine spatial details required for synthesis. To address these challenges, HiUni introduces a \emph{Pixel Diffusion Head} tailored to direct pixel-space optimization and a lightweight \emph{HiGate} pathway that provides fine-grained spatial details near the output stage. Extensive experiments show that HiUni achieves a similar average understanding score to the pretrained VLM while attaining competitive performance on image generation and editing. Controlled comparisons and analyses further demonstrate that a single dense backbone can effectively support both capabilities without task-specific backbone computation, highlighting a simpler path toward unified multimodal modeling.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HiUni，让同一个语言对齐 ViT 与稠密 Transformer 主干同时承担视觉理解与生成，任务特定计算只放在输出侧，包括面向像素空间优化的 Pixel Diffusion Head 和补充细粒度空间细节的轻量 HiGate 通路，实验显示理解分数接近预训练 VLM、生成与编辑具有竞争力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其关键观察「预训练 ViT 的语义抽象会丢弃合成所需的细粒度空间细节」与 LVR 关注的内部状态是否保留视觉细节、以及视觉旁路设计相关；HiGate 在输出阶段注入细节的做法可供核查是否可作 latent 推理中细节保真通路的线索，但该文本身未研究 latent 推理。
